plan_questions_answered_at_check.name: plan_questions_answered_at_check
plan_questions_answered_at_check.value: ("plan_questions"."answered_at" IS NULL) = ("plan_questions"."answer_choice" IS NULL AND "plan_questions"."answer_text" IS NULL)

repository_setups_started_check.name: repository_setups_started_check
repository_setups_started_check.value: "repository_setups"."status" = 'scanned' OR ("repository_setups"."selection" IS NOT NULL AND "repository_setups"."job" IS NOT NULL)

repository_setups_pull_request_check.name: repository_setups_pull_request_check
repository_setups_pull_request_check.value: "repository_setups"."status" NOT IN ('pr_open', 'complete') OR "repository_setups"."pull_request_number" IS NOT NULL

runs_started_at_check.name: runs_started_at_check
runs_started_at_check.value: "runs"."status" IN ('failed', 'cancelled') OR ("runs"."started_at" IS NOT NULL) = ("runs"."status" IN ('running', 'succeeded'))
